# dsh-plugin-dev
A stable vocabulary and architectural decision skill for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and Cordis — written
for coding agents and the people who collaborate with them.
It establishes the canonical DSH/Cordis Context and a requirement-to-seam Decision Tree. Version-spe
cific API catalogs, Slot inventories, and community implementation surveys are intentionally exclude
d: verify those details against the current DSH official documentation and source when implementing.
MIT licensed — use it, fork it, ship it.
